findings.highlight: First of all, killing doesn't suit you."
findings.evidenceJa: そもそもイリヤには、こんな殺し合いは似合わない」
findings.governingReading: Shirou says this kind of murderous struggle between participants does not suit Illya.
findings.explanation: This mutual killing becomes killing in general.

findings.highlight: "Teehee. I may consider it if you become my Servant. If you did that, I wouldn't have to kill you."
findings.evidenceJa: 「くす。そうね、シロウがわたしのサーヴァントになってくれるならやめてもいいよ。そうすれば、シロウを殺さなくてよくなるもの」
findings.governingReading: Illya says she is willing to stop if Shirou becomes her Servant.
findings.explanation: Illya’s conditional agreement becomes only considering it.

findings.highlight: Command Spells, Masters, none of that matters.
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪もマスターもない。
findings.governingReading: In Shirou’s reading, Illya’s personal meaning of Servant contains neither Command Spells nor the Master system.
findings.explanation: Command Spells and Masters absent from Illya’s conception become merely irrelevant.

findings.highlight: "What!? I made a concession because I was talking to you! You're going to pay for it!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「っ……！　シロウだから譲歩してあげたのに、そんなコト言うんならもう知らないんだから……！」
findings.governingReading: Embarrassed that Shirou rejected her concession, Illya says that if he talks that way she wants nothing more to do with him.
findings.explanation: “Then I’m done with you” becomes a retaliation threat.
